title: Transparency of Racial Quota under Ethnic Integration Policy during Selling and Buying of HDB Flats
what_it_is: Transparency of Racial Quota under Ethnic Integration Policy during Selling and Buying of HDB Flats

sections.label: HDB Ethnic Integration Policy sales
sections.summary: HDB applies the Ethnic Integration Policy to all HDB flat sales, updating ethnic proportions monthly, granting extensions and flexibility in exceptional cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how does HDB ensure the racial quota under the Ethnic Integration Policy (EIP) during the selling and buying process to ensure fairness and transparency to all parties; (b) what assistance is provided to sellers who are unable to sell their flat due to the EIP despite the many extensions given for them to sell their flat; and (c) whether HDB can exercise flexibility to allow a sale transaction to go through especially in circumstances where the seller cannot find a suitable buyer for a particular ethnic group.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It applies to the sale and purchase of all HDB flats and is implemented in a fair and transparent manner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The ethnic proportions are updated on the first day of every month and they apply to all completed resale applications received during that month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For those who are unable to sell their flats, HDB may grant them an extension of time and advise them to be realistic with their asking prices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Additionally, HDB has and will continue to exercise flexibility for households of mixed parentage or marriages, or where there are exceptional circumstances.
